title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in prison
content: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
content: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms
content: Democrats are likely to launch investigations into Musk's influence, including his leadership of DOGE and government contracts

title: Democratic leaders reflect on midterm results and what's next for the party
content: Democratic party leaders and political analysts spoke with Morning Edition about the results of the midterm elections, the effects of mid-decade redistricting efforts, and the next steps for the party.

title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
content: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

title: Navajo voters hop tractors, make extraordinary efforts to vote after widespread flooding
content: Four weeks of flooding washed out roads and sent thousands fleeing their homes on the Navajo Reservation. But many worked hard to get to polling places and voting day became part of the recovery process.

title: Herbert Blomstedt, conductor of great orchestras for seven decades, dies at 99
content: Modest in his demeanor but remarkably enduring, the American-born, Swedish conductor continually fell in love with music, leading orchestras with no-nonsense insight and integrity well into his 90s.

title: Chuck Schumer heralds Democrats' 'generational remake' of Senate
content: In remarks the day after his party flipped control of Congress, the Senate Minority Leader said voters had spoken clearly about their priorities, and said it's up to the Democratic party to deliver.

title: Mike Johnson will step aside as top House Republican next Congress
content: After Tuesday's bruising defeat for Republicans, House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as minority leader come January.

title: Back in the majority, Democrats have plans for a long list of Trump investigations
content: Democrats will have the ability to subpoena records and compel individuals to testify. The Epstein files, Elon Musk, the Iran war and Trump's business interests may all come under the microscope.
